highlights: Duplicate any configuration, network, contact, location, domain, or flexible asset from its detail page — the form opens pre-filled, with unique fields like serial numbers and MAC addresses left empty for you to fill in

Domains with a linked registrar credential now sync automatically every night — expiry date, nameservers, auto-renew, and DNSSEC always stay current, with a manual sync button for when you don't want to wait
Creating a flexible asset now takes you straight to its detail page
